a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build the reserve to 8 almost certainly leaves us both at 0 when a storm hits. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the agreement quietly. If you'd rather operate, say so. After round 1 I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4, and I'll give cells back if that helps you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for you to reach 4. If a leak or anything else puts you short, tell me and I'll give cells back where I can.
